admission.justification: A domain classified but never watched looks wired and is not: the queue would refresh only when something else happened to wake it. The wiring cases check the roots themselves and that a store write wakes its own domain with no poll.

applicability: The watcher roots and projection domains that carry the native attention inputs.
conditions: Held stores under workspace/.ar-product are acquired through bounded readers, while the queue, receipt and control-plane roots supply the watched invalidations that wake their domains, and each watched root maps to one projection domain.
A write to a notice or held-queue store wakes its domain without a host poll.
The archive and worktree trees are never watched by the recursive lane.
exclusions: Any added host poll or bridge child.
Watching an unbounded tree to reach a store.
Rereading a domain whose root reported no change once its acquisition is initialized and complete.

evidence: notes/reports/reviewer/267804e5-dd71-51e8-8f1d-d975effaaeaf/role-launch/round4/L190-fix-verification-R4.json#L190-R1-F10; Prior sealed closure retained; not reopened in fixed-list R4.

statement: Existing native invalidation roots refresh the new held and control-plane inputs without adding host polls.
